dialog.mad_scientist.convert.question: I have all the parts!
dialog.mad_scientist.junkie.cocktail_que: You-you-you have to help me, buddy, you see.
I have-have this [§6burp§r] amazing recipe, buddy, just amazing things with stuff mixed together, buddy.
It - it's gonna be better than... no it's incomparable, buddy, it's the pinnacle of perfection, buddy [§6burp§r].
But you see I need these things, buddy! I-I need some of that creeper POWDER, buddy and-and [§6burp§r] some mushrooms from the NETHER!
But see here now, buddy! Hey, stop scratching your ass, buddy, it's v-v-very important!
That powder stuff from the creeper keeps its potency only if you kill it with a shovel, buddy.
Yes, a shovel, buddy, you-you have to smash its brains out, repeated blunt traumas, buddy, to get the good stuff!
Now, go, buddy, quickly, buddy, go!
I have all the ingredients for your cocktail.
Ah yes, now let me get these thing out of you buddy, take the burden of your shoulders, let me just mix up a batch and.... [§6junkie scientist mixes up the ingredients and takes a snort....§r]
You said something about a cocktail?
dialog.mad_scientist.main.line.0.android: Ah %1$s, good to see you! What brings you here?
dialog.mad_scientist.main.line.1.android: Hello there. You look splendid today!
dialog.mad_scientist.main.line.1.human: NO! I can't even look at you. So fragile!
dialog.mad_scientist.main.line.2.android: It seems your left eye is out of alignment. I'll be glad to fix it.
dialog.mad_scientist.main.line.2.human: Are you ok ? You look trapped! How can you stand that flesh?
dialog.mad_scientist.requirements.line:
Finally!
Getting rid of that fragile body is the best choice.
The only problem is that I need you to bring me a set of Android parts before we begin.
dialog.mad_scientist.requirements.questi: I want to become an android.
dialog.mad_scientist.trade_route_quest.0: It can't be! I thought it was lost when he died. I can't thank you enough for this. Here take this..
Do you know anything about this trade route agreement?
dialog.mad_scientist.trade_route_quest.1: What do you mean? It's nothing really, just some self-sealing stem bolts.
I noticed the price, what are you trading?
dialog.mad_scientist.undo.line: Why would you want to do that? The only way is by swallowing a blue pill. It can be found in dungeons, but your best bet is to buy it from someone. I think I had some in my workshop. I'll have to check.
dialog.mad_scientist.undo.question: How do I reverse it!
dialog.mad_scientist.whatDidYouDo.line: You are now an Android! You will no longer need food, sleep or oxygen. You can upgrade yourself with wonderful abilities in an Android Station and you will be able to see and do things you never imagined.
dialog.mad_scientist.whatDidYouDo.questi: What did you do to me?

quest.beast_belly.info: There is no easy way to say this, but we need you to die for us. For science! Have you ever encountered strange gravitational anomalies? We can't figure out exactly what happens then matter is introduced into their event horizon. We can see it growing, but where does all that matter go ? We want you to travel into the event horizon of a gravitational anomaly and see what mysteries lie within. Be careful, it might hurt a bit.
quest.beast_belly.title: The belly of the beast
quest.cocktail_of_ascension.info: A Crazy scientist has asked you to bring him %2$s gunpowder from a shoveled creeper and %3$s red mushrooms from the darkest depths of the Nether, for his Cocktail Of Ascension.
quest.cocktail_of_ascension.objective.2: Pickup %2$s/%3$s red mushrooms from the Nether
quest.cocktail_of_ascension.objective.3: Talk to the crazy scientist junkie
quest.cocktail_of_ascension.title: Cocktail of Ascension
quest.crash_landing.info:
Captain's Log stardate 48940.8.
/
/I've had to initiate emergency landing procedures. My ship's port nacelle is completely fried. I have enough emergency rations to last me for a while, but the watter tank was ruptured.
/I must get out and find fresh water pronto.
/From what I can gather by looking at the star charts , I seem to have crashed somewhere in the orion sector. Last I heard the whole sector was overwhelmed with Edux rejects.
/I guess that means I won't find anybody to talk to in a while.
/To think this happened just before I got to finally visit Emily for the first time, in 5 years.
quest.crash_landing.objective.0: Build a $craftItem and try to hack the terminal to contact the captain's family.
quest.crash_landing.title: Crash Landing
quest.department_of_agriculture.info: To all willing hands. This is a job offer from the department of agriculture. We operate in the desolate world of Barus V and you can image the obstacles we face when it comes to growing %3$s. As our plans for hydroponic farms come to turn, our people starve to death. We are searching for capable parties to aid us in the supplying of %3$s shipments to our citizens in need.
quest.department_of_agriculture.title: Department of Agriculture
quest.gmo.info:
Replicating vegetables! That's just absurd!
/They taste awful, all those replicated stuff feel just like eating plastic.
/No no, we need something different. I just got my new biolistic particle delivery system and I can't wait to test that baby out. I see all these pathetic villagers planting their crops, crawling in the dirt like animals. I just need to get my hands on some crop gene sequences. The thing is these brainless, villagers won't let me anywhere near the crops. Can you use my Data Pad and scan some for me? I'm sure I can give you something for the favor. I had some old android parts laying around.
quest.gmo.objective.0: Scan $scanAmount/$maxScanAmount $block with the Scientist's Data Pad.
quest.gmo.title: G.M.O.
quest.is_it_really_me.info: Our investors have finally decided to let us begin human trails. We are all ready to proceed whenever you are. We have done rigorous testing on animals and inanimate objects and the fail rate is well below 25%. We can assure you that everything will go according to plan. Of course there is still the matter of the psychological barriers, we don't know how exactly the Edux got over them, but we are positive you can push yourself to do it. Just step onto the platform and close your eyes.
quest.is_it_really_me.title: Is it really me ?
quest.kill_androids.info: The are taking over the world! I don't know how exactly they got here, but there numbers are growing by the day. It's seems like there's no end to them. We must fight for if we don't, we will all perish. The fight starts with you $player! We need you to help us kill as many of them as possible, before they get us all.
quest.kill_androids.title: They will kill us all!
quest.one_true_love.info: I'm so happy! You can't even imagine what a joyous moment this is! Merry has finally agreed to merry me. You don't even know how many times I've tried to win her heart. At long last her father gave us his blessing. I know our love is more than enough to keeps us going, but I wanted to give her something special. I was hoping you can find me a diamond so I can put a marvelous ring onto her precious finger. I will forever be in dept and I will be more than happy to compensate for you troubles.
quest.one_true_love.title: One true love
quest.puny_humans.info: I have spoken to scientist, who is obviously mad, but makes quite the offering. He has agreed to turn me into an android. All I need to do is collect a full set of Android Parts for the procedure. Rouge Androids seem to be the only ones who drop these parts.
quest.puny_humans.objective.0: Collect a full set of android parts
quest.puny_humans.title: Puny Humans
quest.sacrifice.info: We are the Dark Vail. We have begun restoring an ancient artifact, the effects of which will remain a secret. All we need from you $player is to sacrifice $maxKillCount animal newborns in the name of the dark lord, whose name strikes fear in the hearts of the innocent. Barry the dark lord. You will be compensated handsomely for your efforts.
quest.sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
quest.stem_bolts.info.0:
After speaking with the Mad Scientist, you were left with an unwary feeling. The scientist was keeping something from you.
/You had that feeling ever since you saw the trade route agreement, so you decided to make a copy, before giving it to the scientist. You realise you might have missed something.
quest.stem_bolts.info.1: You found it! A small text at the end, reefers to a disclaimer stating that the shipping party will not be responsible for any undesirable mutations caused by Ionizing radiation. You begin to wonder what sort of cargo can have mutations. You decide to revisit the cargo ship for more clues.
quest.stem_bolts.title: Self-Sealing Stem Bolts
quest.to_the_power_of.info: Before I can begin work on my ascension from my limiting mortality I need to ensure a consistent source of power.
quest.to_the_power_of.title: To the power of
quest.trade_route.info:
I know the Orion sector is not the safest place to go through, but where is, these days. I can't even wrap my head around how the Edux managed to miss such a potential flaw. I mean what were they thinking? Were they that selfish?
/Anyhow, I know I've lost a lot of friends traveling through the Orion sector, but the pay is just too damn good.
/The crew will be dropping the cargo in the nearest village, I might even join them, but first, I have to take care of something I promised to a friend.
quest.trade_route.info.2: As you open the captain's chest, you find a $itemName, signed with a digital seal, indicating the establishment of a trade route between Ticonderoga and Overworld. You don't fully understand the language but you quickly notice the unmistakable price. A ridiculous amount of emeralds even for a trade route. You start to wonder, exactly what trade requires such an enormous amount of emeralds. Maybe you should ask one of the Scientists down on the planet.
quest.trade_route.objective.0: Find the captain's chest and open it
quest.trade_route.title: Trading Routes
quest.we_must_know.info:
Thank you for contacting us.
/I still find this whole ordeal shocking. I know we weren't on the best of terms for quite some time, but I just can't imagine what my daughter feels right now.
/Emily is quite a strong woman, but she didn't take the news very well.
/I have one last request of you. As his commanding officer It's my duty to honor the death of a fellow solder. Hell it's the least I can do.
/Will you put down the $block I've sent you so that we can retrieve all of his logs. I know he cared deeply for my Emily and I hope there is something in there to put my daughter's mind at ease.
quest.we_must_know.objective.0: Place the $block near the ship at $distance away.
quest.we_must_know.title: We must know
quest.weapons_of_war.info: They have oppressed us for long enough! Our proud people will no longer stand for this. Years of oppression, end now! We may be broken in body be we are strong in spirit. This is where we need your help. It may not be pretty, but war is coming and we need a way to defend ourselves. They will throw everything they have at us. The first step of many, is to build anvils use them to forge the weapons we desperately need.
quest.weapons_of_war.title: Weapons of war
screen.matteroverdrive.reactor_guide.coi: Place coil-capable blocks in the highlighted positions. A Reactor IO may replace any coil and multiple IO ports are supported. The two positions immediately beside the controller are flexible special positions.
screen.matteroverdrive.reactor_guide.hul: Fill all sixteen remaining ring positions with Machine Hulls. The two controller-side positions may instead be coils, IO ports, hulls, or decomposers. Put the anomaly at the centre, up to three blocks above or below the ring.
screen.matteroverdrive.reactor_guide.ope: Machines inside the ring on the controller level share available reactor FE without cables; a Decomposer in either flexible controller-side slot does too. External machines require a Heavy Energy Cable connected to Reactor IO. Reactor output capacity scales with anomaly mass. Feed matter through linked IO, keep powered stabilizer beams clear, and throw items into the anomaly to increase its mass and output.
screen.matteroverdrive.reactor_guide.ove: Build an 11 x 11 horizontal ring. The controller sits at the middle of one edge, and the ring extends in the direction you faced when placing it. The gravitational anomaly belongs at the ring centre, five blocks forward.
